_comment: Breaking-change notes for popular GitHub Actions, keyed by owner/repo. Used by version-audit.mjs to annotate REVIEW_MAJOR findings. NOT a source of 'latest' — latest is always queried live from the releases API. Update as new majors ship.

actions/checkout.note: v2 made shallow clone the default (fetch-depth:1) — set fetch-depth:0 if you need full history/git-describe. v7 restricts fork-PR checkout under pull_request_target/workflow_run.

actions/setup-node.note: Mostly runtime bumps across majors; low input-breakage risk, but still read the changelog.

actions/setup-python.note: v4+ requires python-version or python-version-file — step fails if neither is set.

actions/setup-java.note: v2+ requires the 'distribution' input (temurin/corretto/zulu); v1 silently defaulted.

actions/setup-go.note: v4+ enables module caching by default — conflicts with a manual actions/cache for Go modules (set cache:false).

actions/cache.note: cache-hit is 'true' only on an EXACT key match; a restore-keys partial hit reports cache-hit:false.

actions/upload-artifact.note: v3 SHUT DOWN on github.com (2024-11-30). v4 artifacts are immutable — cannot upload the same name twice in one run (use unique names or overwrite:true); v3<->v4 wire-incompatible, must match download-artifact major.

actions/download-artifact.note: v3 SHUT DOWN (2024-11-30). v4 backend is incompatible with v3 uploads — upload/download majors must match.

github/codeql-action.note: Monorepo (init/analyze/autobuild are subdirs); releases/latest returns a codeql-bundle tag, not the action version — resolve via semver tags. v1/v2 deprecated.

docker/build-push-action.note: v6 switched default provenance/SBOM attestations on; can change image digests and break strict registries.

actions/deploy-pages.note: Track alongside actions/upload-pages-artifact — version skew between them breaks Pages deploys.
